entity: Nursing-home dialysis brands (Dialyze Direct, Dialysis Direct, Concerto) flagged worse on survival
why: The Kidney360 study covers the same nursing-home dialysis model and gives numbers (no worsened death at 42 days) under a wholly different definition than CMS's SMR flags, so the numbers can't be lined up. The CMS guide is methodology, not a finding. Entity naming in the quote itself is thin.
